Possession and evaluation are author reports; no transfer instrument or original Gascoigne paper identified.

Extract repeats possession of Gascoigne optical papers and adverse evaluation, including ray-incidence/intersection/projection calculations. Same letter transmission, not independent custody confirmation or proof of instrument performance.

Reverse includes address to Collins and docket mentioning Horrocks/Gascoigne papers, Newton telescope and Cassini. Docket handwriting/date not authenticated; two delivered surfaces distinguished from catalog one-page extent.

Continuation discusses reflective telescope limitations and Cassini ephemerides, closes with original entered in letter-book/supplement notation. Catalog identifies extract by Henry Oldenburg; no autograph inference from creator field.
